118994.note: The pin is on the drawn loop by the road junction, in open pines with a building beside it. The listing's own point is 36.8 km away (a bad listing point), but the loop is plainly a small camp.

231845.note: The pin is on the bare pad of the group site in the open, with tables beside it; the dirt road from the drawn forest road up to the pad was traced.

231949.note: The pin sits under oaks beside the drawn lane off the road, but the drawn lane cuts through the trees west of the visible paved lane, which runs past the pin 10 m east; nothing at the pin itself marks the group site.

231955.note: The Forest Service's point, 1.1 km southeast, is in open lodgepole by bare pumice with only faint tracks nearby, no pad or loop that is plainly the group camp, and the pin still isn't confirmed either. Not moved.

231964.note: The pin is on a ranch compound of buildings, trailers and corrals at the end of the drawn road, not a campground, and the listing's own point is 29 km away.

231965.note: The pin and the Forest Service's point (8 m apart) both sit in the bare patch where the drawn road ends in open pinyon, but the photo shows no pads, toilet or parking that mark the group camp. Not moved.

231966.note: The Forest Service's point, 170 m northwest of the pin, is among sage and pinyon 35 m north of the dirt lane that continues the drawn road, with no pad, tables or toilet; the pin, in open pinyon east of the road, shows nothing either. Not moved.

232020.note: The pin is on the drawn road where it crosses an open bare flat among the pines, the camp's clearing.

232041.note: The Forest Service's point 76 m northeast lands on the drawn entrance road under the trees, and the pin is inside the drawn loop; neither spot shows a group pad, so the pin isn't moved.

232100.note: The pin is on the small paved loop at the end of the drawn spur, with a shelter or restroom inside it. The listing's own point is 1.2 km away.

232111.note: The pin is on the edge of the small paved lot at the end of the drawn spur off the highway, with a shelter beside it.

232208.note: The Forest Service's point, 120 m east of the pin, is in open ponderosa with no pad, loop or tables; the pin is in pinyon 30 m west of the bare pad at the end of the drawn east lane, which has a small roof (perhaps a toilet) beside it, but nothing marks that pad plainly as the group site. Not moved.

232302.note: The pin is on the bare clearing where the drawn road meets its small loop above the lake.

232351.note: The Forest Service point matched here is Green Canyon group campground, a different camp from Green Spot, so it was not used; the pin is still in open juniper scrub with nothing that could be the equestrian camp. Not moved.

232362.note: The Forest Service's point, 135 m east of the pin, is under unbroken conifers with no lane, pad or clearing, 70 m east of the drawn spur's loop; the pin, between the spurs, shows nothing either. Not moved.

232397.note: The lidar survey covers only 2% of the frame and nothing near the pin (0 ground points per square meter here), so neither layer shows anything; on the photo the pin is under trees on the river bank below the drawn trail, with no clearing, and the listing's own point is 300 m away. Nothing traced.

232401.note: The pin is among the cabins of the station, a few metres from the ranger cabin. The gravel road through the station wasn't drawn and was traced; the drawn lane south from the cabin loop crosses ground where no lane shows.

232407.note: The lidar intensity shows the group site's lane plainly under the firs, running south from the campground road to a small turnaround loop; the spur is redrawn on its middle and the loop added. The pin sits 18 m east of the lane, where neither layer nor the photo shows a pad or clearing, so the site itself can't be placed.

232763.note: Under the oaks the lidar relief shows a crowned lane coming in from the west and a round loop about 35 m across south of the pin; OpenStreetMap's loop ran 10 m outside it on the west and up through the pin on the north, so the lane's last 40 m and the loop are redrawn on the relief. The pin sits 20 m north of the loop with nothing at it, and the listing's own point is 730 m away, so the group site can't be placed.

232764.note: The pin sits on an open grassy bench among oaks 30 m east of the end of the drawn lane, where faint lanes show; nothing drawn reaches it, and no lane is plain enough to trace.

232765.note: Unchanged. Zoomed, the pin (GS) sits under the trees on a point above the lake's drawdown flats with no lane, pad or clearing at it; the nearest camp is a paved loop with parked cars beside the drawn road 180 m south-west, which may be the group site or another campground, so the pin wasn't moved.

232786.note: The pin sits on open ground on a trail between drawn lanes, with nothing at it that marks a group site; the listing's own point is 1.6 km away.

232797.note: The pin is in the paved loop of a large clearing in the forest, and the drawn loop follows the pavement off the road. The listing's own point is 600 m away.

232808.note: The Forest Service's point, 371 m south, is among bare patches in open lodgepole with what may be vehicles or tents nearby, but no group pad or loop can be told apart there, and the pin shows none either. Not moved.

233096.note: The pin is on the bare strip of the group site in the trees; the dirt lane on from the end of the drawn spur down the strip was traced.

233097.note: The Forest Service's point, 130 m southwest of the pin, is on the paved campground road itself, with no pad there; a bare dirt area with two pale tarps or tents 40 m south of it may be a group site, but Hirz Bay has two group camps and nothing marks this one as Group 2. The pin is on a wooded slope with nothing at it. Not moved.

233113.note: The pin is on the drawn road through open pines above the lake, beside a small structure in the camp's clearing.

233161.note: Moved the pin 165 m southeast, from a burned stand onto the group camp: a bare levelled area with a row of five picnic tables and a white-roofed toilet beside it, 15 m north of the end of the drawn loop, where the Forest Service puts Masterson.

233166.note: The pin is on a small opening in thick forest 20 m north of the drawn trail, but no cabin roof shows; the trail is the way in, and no road reaches within 300 m.

233202.note: The pin is on the drawn lakeshore lane at a bare pull-out between the lane and the water, with the restroom beside it.

233224.note: Under pine canopy, the ground relief shows only even forest floor at the pin and at the Forest Service's point 26 m west, with no levelled pad marking the group area. Not moved.

233233.note: Neither the pin nor the Forest Service's point 232 m south (under pines beside the drawn road) shows a group pad; a small clearing with a fire ring and a dirt loop 45 to 50 m south of the point may be a camp but can't be told as this group site. Not moved.

233234.note: The Forest Service point matched here is Treasure Park East's, a different group site from this North one, so it was not used; the pin, in pine forest between two drawn roads, still shows nothing that marks the site. Not moved.

233290.note: The pin is on the bare camp area beside the drawn loop, where a tent and vehicles stand, and the loop joins the road.

233356.note: The pin sits on open ground in scattered pines, 30 m north of the end of a drawn spur, with a bare trampled area that could be the corral; buildings and an undrawn dirt lane lie 80 m north. The listing's own point is 330 m away.

233358.note: The pin sits in lodgepole forest 20 m south of the end of the drawn spur, where a small bare patch shows; no corral is plain, and the listing's own point is 880 m away.

233399.note: The pin sits in open grassland among junipers 30 m south of the drawn loop at the end of the road, where tables and a shelter show; nothing drawn reaches the pin itself.

233737.note: The pin is on the drawn lane in the open flat beside the highway, the group site's clearing.

233820.note: Both the pin and the Forest Service's point, 352 m southeast, are in closed conifer forest with no clearing, lane or building that could be the organization camp. Not moved.

233825.note: The pin is beside the warming hut on the edge of the bare clearing, and the drawn road through the clearing passes 15 m from it.

233838.note: The pin is in the open meadow between the river and the highway, near the undrawn gravel lot; the drawn roads lie across the river or end at the lot, and none reaches the pin.

233943.note: The pin is on the gravel pad beside the building, on the drawn loop off the road by the lake.

233945.note: The pin is 15 m north of the guard station building, below the drawn loop at the station's yard; a faint track runs from the loop down to the building but isn't drawn. The listing's own point is 500 m away.

233948.note: The pin is on the barrack building, between the highway and the drawn loop of the work center, 25 m from the loop.

233960.note: The pin is on the cabin in the open flat beside the drawn road, by the airstrip.

233996.note: The pin is on a green-roofed shelter above the lake shore; it is reached by boat, so no road or trail is drawn, as expected.

233999.note: The pin is on the open bare area beside the drawn loops of the group campground, and the loops join the road.

234000.note: The Forest Service's point, 1.7 km west, is in open pinyon with only faint tracks and no group pad or loop, and the pin is still in open scrub with nothing at it. Not moved.

234034.note: The pin is on the small cabin in the meadow 30 m west of the drawn road; a faint track to it shows, but not plainly enough to trace.

234065.note: The pin is on a bare gravel clearing at the end of a drawn spur, beside the lake campground's lanes. The listing's own point is 7.1 km away, but the clearing fits a group site.

234148.note: The pin sits on the drawn loop of the group site, with a small white structure about 10 m north-west on the photo and another roof by the loop's west end, but the loop and its pads don't show under the firs, and the lidar relief (Oregon DOGAMI) shows only the terrace edges and mottled forest floor here. The loop can't be checked to 3 m, so it stays unsure.

234203.note: Through gaps in the canopy the photo shows the drawn loop's gravel lane, with pale pull-ins off it, and the lidar relief shows the levelled terrace it sits on between the creek channels; the drawn loop follows the gravel within a few meters, and the pin is at the loop's entrance, which reads as the group campground. The intensity is too mottled to add anything. Nothing traced.

234215.note: The pin is on the small clearing with a building in the forest, 30 m east of the drawn road that passes it, where a lane leads in.

234234.note: The pin sits among trees between the two drawn loops of the group area, 20 m west of the lane; the loops are on visible gravel, but nothing at the pin itself marks the site. The listing's own point is 1.1 km away.

234245.note: The pin is in the cabin compound, between drawn lanes with cabins along them, off the road.

234260.note: The pin is on the guard station's green roof 25 m east of the drawn road, with a second building beside it; the short drive in doesn't show plainly enough to trace.

234275.note: The Forest Service's point, 1 km southwest, lies at the edge of an undrawn campground of dirt lanes and small pads in the pines, but no one pad or loop there is plainly the group site, so the pin wasn't moved; it is still on an industrial-looking building by the road.

234312.note: The pin sits in sagebrush 50 m east of the drawn loop, in the open between aspen stands; no lane or pad at it shows, and the listing's own point is 730 m away.

234319.note: The pin was in plain forest 45 m south of the trailhead lot; it is moved 43 m east-southeast onto the only building near it, a long gray roof the photo shows among the trees, beside a levelled patch in the lidar relief. The drawn lot is 50 m north of it and no lane to the building shows, so nothing else is traced (the frame moved with the pin, so its ground layer is now stale).

234344.note: The pin sits on a bare strip in the forest 10 m north of the drawn lane along the meadow, where horse trailers stand; no lane to the pin itself shows.

234380.note: The pin is on the open camp area with tents and trailers beside the drawn roads' junction, and the roads reach it.

234398.note: The pin is on the station's green-roofed building beside the drawn road.

234412.note: The pin is on a building of the old nursery's yard, and the drawn lanes of the yard reach it.

234443.note: The pin is on a grassy clearing 40 m south of a building compound in the forest; a dirt drive serves the compound, but no drawn road comes within 240 m and the way out to the road isn't plain enough to trace. The listing's own point is 1.2 km away.

234446.note: The pin is on the cabin on the open bench, 20 m above the drawn lane that leaves the road.

234449.note: The pin is on the open ground beside the cabin at the drawn junction, where the drawn spur passes 10 m north.

234452.note: The pin is on the drawn turnaround loop at the end of the road, beside the group area's buildings.

234466.note: The Forest Service's point ("Timberlane Pavilion"), 150 m east of the pin, is under forest on the creek bank with a little bare ground but no roof or pad, and the pin is under unbroken forest too; nothing marks the group site at either. Not moved.

234519.note: The Forest Service point matched here is the lake's group picnic area, a different site from this group campsite, so it was not used; the pin still sits in forest with no clearing, 30 m from the area's gravel loops. Not moved.

234532.note: The pin is at the guard station's roof at the forest edge; the dirt track from the drawn road's corner to it was traced.

234576.note: The pin is in the group area's open camp, among trailers and tents inside the drawn loop, which follows the visible lanes.

234771.note: The listing's own point is on a teal-roofed building at the end of a drawn lane, 270 m southeast of the pin, which was in open pasture; the pin now sits on that building.

250004.note: The pin is on open meadow 11 m from where the drawn road ends in a gravel lot; an undrawn gravel lane with pull-outs runs on 80 m southeast, which may be the group site's own, so the pin can't be tied to a pad.

250047.note: The pin is on the gravel pull-off beside the highway where the drawn loop starts, but the drawn loop runs through trees where only its first part shows; nothing at the pin marks the group site.

251579.note: The pin moved 1.7 km southwest onto the guard station's dark roof the photo shows on the Forest Service's point, at the edge of a snowy meadow. A drawn road passes 13 m south, but under the snow it can't be checked against a lane.

251710.note: The pin is on the corral, a fenced square with a structure beside it, 15 m south of the drawn loop where horse trailers park.

251825.note: The pin is on the bare rock beside the cabin, at the drawn loop where the road ends and the trail begins.

251847.note: The drawn spur loop follows the gravel parking strip the photo shows beside the highway within about 3 m, and the pin sits 15 m south of the strip's end, where the lidar intensity shows a lighter patch and the photo faint pale ground under the trees; but neither layer shows a pad or clearing edge plainly enough to read as the group site. Nothing traced.

272095.note: The pin is on the round bare clearing of the group camp, 20 m past the end of the drawn spur, which reaches the clearing's edge by a shelter.

273375.note: The pin is in burned forest 50 m east of the drawn loop; zoomed in, the loop crosses trees with no plain lane, and its only object is a small blue patch that may be a tent or vehicle, so nothing plainly marks the group camp.

273376.note: The pin sits in open forest between two drawn roads, 40 m from each, with only small natural gaps around it; nothing marks the group campground.

273378.note: The Forest Service point matched here is Hirz Bay campground's group site, a different kind of unit from the Hirz cabin, so it was not used; the pin is still on bare ground by the lake with no cabin. Not moved.

10048189.note: The pin is at the end of the drawn trail from the small loop off the road, at the edge of the clearing above the creek, with a structure at the loop.

10165535.note: Unchanged. The point is in open water about 70 m off the island's east shore; zoomed on a 10 m grid the island shows only forest, a bare beach and a grassy flat, with no tents, tables or cleared sites, so there is no campground plainly shown to move the pin onto.

10171272.note: The pin is on the drawn road where the group area's loops meet, in the open meadow.

10176099.note: The pin is on the ranger house in the station yard; the gravel drive from the drawn road east to the house was traced.

10253029.note: The pin is on Shelter 2, a roofed shelter on the point, at the end of the drawn spur off the road.

10253032.note: The pin is on the shelter on the bare knoll, ringed by the drawn lane off the road.
